name.value: Stoke Hotel SureStay Collection by Best Western

description.value: The Stoke Hotel is a SureStay Collection property by Best Western situated in Revelstoke in the Selkirk Mountains, directly across from the Revelstoke Suspension Bridge with mountain views. Rooms feature décor celebrating Canadian heritage, and the property offers pet-friendly accommodations with kitchenettes and jetted tubs. It sits a short distance from downtown Revelstoke, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area.
